Chhattisgarh Agriculture Dept Employees' Pay Hike Likely After High Court Hearing

Employees of the Chhattisgarh Agriculture Department may see an increase in their salaries and allowances. The state government informed the Bilaspur High Court about this possibility. The court was presented with information regarding the potential pay hike for these employees.
